description: $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the first call returns the payment terms, pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). Connects to host:443 and reports the certificate: trusted or not (and why), hostname match, issuer, valid from/to, days left, expired / expiring within 21 days, SAN list, wildcard, key type and size, serial, SHA-256 fingerprint, OCSP/CA URLs, chain, TLS version, cipher and ALPN. Cached 1 h. ~0.2-1.5 s.

host.description: Public host name, e.g. example.com or www.example.com (a URL also works)

name: ssl_cert
title: SSL/TLS certificate check (expiry, issuer, SANs, chain)
